C1344.title: Post-Quantum Cryptography Faces New Challenge: Breakthrough in Lattice-Based Cryptanalysis
C1344.summary: In January 2026, researchers have pushed attack capabilities against the Shortest Vector Problem (SVP) to nearly 400 dimensions, potentially threatening mainstream post-quantum cryptographic schemes, according to a Science and Technology Daily report.
